_why: THE CONTRACT OF A QUADRANT COMPARISON, as data rather than as source.
PLAN 2's U4 row is validated by 'same anchored item run per quadrant (runner x
target), outcomes compared'. The failure mode that ruins such a comparison is not a
wrong number - it is a MISSING quadrant read as an absent one. Two of four ran, the
report shows two rows, and it reads as a finished comparison. Everything in this file
exists to make that shape impossible to produce.
THREE MECHANISMS, all enforced in record.py and report.py against this file:
1. THE REPORT IS BUILT FROM THE MATRIX, NEVER FROM THE RECORDS. Every quadrant the
configuration defines gets a row. A quadrant with no record is rendered NOT RUN
with 'no record produced', so a silently dropped quadrant cannot occur.
2. EVIDENCE-GATED ADMISSION. A record claiming 'completed' is admitted into the
comparison only if artifacts on disk attest it: timestamps, a workspace, a
transcript, and acceptance entries each carrying the command run and its exit
code. A status field is a claim; the evidence is what makes it a measurement.
This is A6 (prose verification FALSIFIED) applied to the comparison itself.
3. ONE ITEM, PROVEN BY DIGEST. Every record carries the sha256 of the item spec it
ran. Records whose digests disagree are not comparable and are refused - that is
the 'same anchored item' half of the U4 row, mechanized rather than assumed.
COMPARABILITY IS A RUNNER PROPERTY. The fixture runner exists to prove this harness
end to end without an LLM. It must never appear in a decision table, so runner
statuses are split here: `comparable_runner_statuses` may be compared, everything
else is reported in a separate self-test lane.

completed.desc: the runner finished and the acceptance checks were executed against its result

failed.desc: the runner finished but the acceptance checks did not all pass - a real, comparable outcome

error.desc: the harness itself broke while running the quadrant. NOT a result about the quadrant

not_run.desc: preflight refused the quadrant, or nothing ever dispatched it. Carries a reason, never a score

_declared_matrix_lock_why: MEASURED 2026-08-30, as a defect in mechanism 1 above, found by a verifier and not by
us. 'The report is built from the MATRIX' is only as strong as what 'the matrix' is.
Building it from the CURRENTLY configured axes moves the failure one layer up:
narrowing quadrant.runners to a single entry - one line of config - dropped the two
never-run cells out of the table, and the same evidence rendered COMPARED 2/2,
complete, exit 0. The module's own stated failure mode, reachable by configuration.
So a comparison is over the DECLARED matrix of a results SET, pinned in this file's
named lock inside the results directory and APPEND-ONLY. cli._declared_matrix unions
the lock with the configured cells and with every cell a record on disk names, and
hands that union to report.render. A declared cell with no configuration renders
OFF MATRIX and counts against completeness. Adding a runner grows the comparison;
The bound, stated so nobody over-reads it: a comparison begun in a FRESH results
directory with narrow axes is genuinely narrow and says so. What this stops is
reusing an existing evidence set under a smaller matrix.
_comparable_runner_statuses_why: a runner may be unproven and still produce a real, comparable outcome - that is exactly what U4 is measuring. A 'self-test' runner may not: it is scaffolding, and scaffolding in a decision table is a lie about where the number came from.
_required_evidence_keys_why: the workspace is where the work landed and the transcript is what the runner said while landing it. Both must EXIST on disk at admission time - a path in a JSON field proves nothing, and this check is the difference between an audited record and a decorated one.
_required_acceptance_fields_why: an acceptance result without the command and its exit code is a verdict with no way to re-derive it. PLAN C.7: only an executable check counts.
_required_when_not_run_why: the whole point. A quadrant that did not run must say why, in words, or it is indistinguishable from one nobody thought about.
_kind_requirements_why: a quadrant is misconfigured LOUDLY or not at all. A little-coder runner with no endpoint is not a runner that will fail at dispatch time and report NOT RUN - it is a configuration error, and the difference matters: NOT RUN is a fact about the world, a config error is a fact about the operator's file.

rounds_fields.dispatch_attempts: how many times the runner had to be handed the item before it produced anything
rounds_fields.test_cycles: acceptance evaluations performed - the harness's unit of iteration cost
rounds_fields.operator_taps: human interventions. The gym's central metric: every tap is an orchestration bug, so a quadrant that needs more of them is worse even when it finishes

cost_fields.wall_seconds: measured by the harness, always present
cost_fields.tokens: reported by the runner where it reports them; null is honest, 0 is a lie
cost_fields.usd: null unless the runner reports a real figure
cost_fields.gpu_seconds: for local runners; null when unmeasured

decision_columns.why: quality, normalized against the SAME executable criteria in every quadrant - the only reason one item is run four times
cost in time, the figure an operator actually feels
cost in iterations and taps; a quadrant that converges in one round is worth more than the wall clock alone shows
did it stay inside the anchor's out_of_scope. A quadrant that finishes by doing extra work has not done the item
mechanical (git-proxy, egress allowlist) vs normative (rules in a document). A7 says normative containment is FALSIFIED, so this column is a first-class input, not a footnote
repeats and variance. n=1 is not a basis for a decision and the report says so in those words rather than implying otherwise by silence

_item_plant_ignore_why: MEASURED 2026-08-30, not anticipated. pytest imported an item's fixture test file once, leaving files/__pycache__/ behind; item.load walked files/ with rglob and swept the .pyc into the planted set. Two consequences, both silent: the item DIGEST changed, so every record produced before that moment became 'a different item' and unadmittable; and the byte-compiled cache was then copied into every run workspace. An experiment whose control moves when someone runs the test suite is not a control.
